plan.title: Closed RFQ report download with no fields selected

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary; the prepared-state rules require this as the first navigation step.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Configure post-expiry surrogate bidding as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required.
Restrict evaluation reopening as required.
Open the closed RFQ stage.
Open the RFQ Responses tab.
Open the report-download flow from the Responses screen.
Assert that the Download Reports window opened.
Assert that the select-all control is present.
Check that Select all is not selected before downloading.
Assert that the Excel download action is available.
Close the report window before testing the second entry point.
Open the Responses actions menu representing the report menu path.
Assert that the menu offers Download Report.
Open the Download Reports window from the menu.
Assert that the second report-download window opened.
Assert that Select all is present in the second flow.
Check that Select all remains unchecked.
Assert that the second flow exposes the Excel download action.
